violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. - Breads found on floor of outside storage unit.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. - Scoop found with handle in product in flour bin.
Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Utensil, bowl-was not suitable or dispensed effectively for self-service operations of ready-to-eat foods. - Bowl found in potatoes for dispensing.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Ice cold storage on cook line found with food items found at 45-56F. Chorizo found at 56F- Sent to landfill Ham-45F moved to cold unit
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Bottom of reach-in freezers needs to be cleaned.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. - Togo items found on floor in back storage area and in storage trailer. - Togo items found unprotected from weather in back storage area.
